answer: Give every new identity a tiny starting quota that grows only through sustained honest participation, like nectar gathered flower by flower rather than seized at once. A sybil farm can mint thousands of accounts, but each begins at the bottom of the slope and must climb toward the summit over weeks of verifiable, useful work before it can transact at scale. Time becomes the bridge no attacker can shortcut: bulk creation yields only negligible aggregate power, while honest agents gradually earn full standing, and misbehavior resets the climb.
